scenes.text: This '50% OFF' tag was born three weeks ago.
scenes.say: [conspiratorial] This fifty-percent-off tag... was born three weeks ago.
scenes.head: HOW A FAKE '50% OFF' TAG IS BORN

scenes.text: Step one. October: the price is $50.
scenes.say: Step one. October. The price is fifty bucks.

scenes.text: Step two. Early November, the price hits the gym. $100.
scenes.say: Step two. Early November... the price hits the gym. A hundred dollars.
Step three. Black Friday! Was a hundred... NOW fifty!

scenes.text: Same fifty bucks. Just wearing a costume.
scenes.say: [deadpan] Same fifty bucks. Just wearing a costume.

scenes.text: Is that allowed? The FTC's pricing guide says the 'was' price must be real.
scenes.say: Is that even allowed? The F.T.C.'s pricing guide says the 'was' price has to be real.
scenes.show_source: FTC Guides Against Deceptive Pricing, 16 CFR 233.1

scenes.text: Offered openly, for a 'reasonably substantial period.' Not a weekend.
scenes.say: Offered openly... for a reasonably substantial period. Not one weekend.

scenes.text: Massachusetts even counts: 28 days out of the last 90.
scenes.say: Massachusetts even counts the days. Twenty-eight out of the last ninety.

scenes.text: Last Black Friday, WalletHub tracked 3,100 deals.
scenes.say: Last Black Friday, WalletHub tracked thirty-one hundred deals.

scenes.text: 36% weren't cheaper than in early November. Some cost MORE.
scenes.say: Thirty-six percent... weren't cheaper than in early November. Some cost MORE.
scenes.show_source: WalletHub Black Friday study, Nov 2025: 3,100 items vs Oct 27–Nov 17 prices

scenes.text: So... ever checked the price a month before?
